items.title: Appxiom
items.source_text: Appxiom Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs Appxiom gives your coding agent the production context it lacks: crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in mobile and web applications. Goal Friction Impact lets agents prioritise bugs by the goals they cost you. items.title: EkLine
items.source_text: EkLine AI SEO for Developer Tools and API first companies!  Your buyers ask ChatGPT which tool to use, then ask Cursor to build with it.
